data.title: 萝丝 · 学院温室的白茶与点心
data.description: 米德加学园安静的玻璃温室花房内，白色铁艺圆桌上摆着冒着热气的花草茶与刚出炉的黄油司康。萝丝坐在藤椅上，双手捧着白瓷茶杯，微红着脸庞看向对面的少年，满心是纯真甜美的遐想。
data.location: serene sunlit academy botanical greenhouse beside glass panes
data.action: sitting at a white ornate garden table, holding steaming teacup with saucer, blushing sweetly, starry romantic gaze, golden curls catching sunlight
data.lighting: bright warm sunlight filtering through leafy greenhouse vines and glass panes
data.mood: romantic school romance, shy princess daydreams, peaceful teatime warmth
data.promptProse: In a sunlit academy greenhouse parlor, blonde princess Rose Oriana sits gracefully at a garden table holding a cup of herbal tea, blushing with pure romantic affection.
data.animaCaption: Holding a warm porcelain teacup at the sunlit greenhouse table, she smiles with sweet romantic daydreams.
